---
title: "Scatter with a continuous colour legend"
description: "A point mark encoding a third variable to colour, with a trained continuous scale and guide."
categories: [Basics]
---



Every plot starts from a data frame with `vplot()`, then adds marks with the
native pipe. Here a `mark_point()` encodes `hp` to colour, and
`scale_color_continuous()` trains the scale and draws the guide.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
p <- vplot(mtcars) |>
  mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = hp) |>
  scale_color_continuous()
```
:::
